description.value: A family-run motel nestled on the shores of Skaha Lake in Penticton, steps from Skaha Lake Park with views of the surrounding mountains. Rooms range from a basic queen to three-bedroom suites, all with full bathrooms and most with in-suite kitchens — practical for touring cyclists wanting to self-cater. A seasonal outdoor pool and BBQ area add to the appeal for warm-weather visitors.

address.value: 3590 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 6G7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms OSM contact details (phone, address, email). The amenities page lists 'Laundry facilities', 'Free Wifi (all rooms & some public areas)', and proximity to Rexall and Walmart for grocery needs; a guest review references 'close to restaurants'. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling infrastructure anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel on Skaha Lake in Penticton with an active website and confirmed contact details — a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists.
